title: ISBN on Cover Doesn't Match: How to Fix It (IngramSpark & KDP) | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix "the ISBN on your cover doesn't match"
description: Your book was rejected because the ISBN on the cover barcode doesn't match the ISBN you entered. Why it happens and how to fix it in minutes.
lead: This one is easy to miss: the cover looks perfect, but the number on the barcode belongs to a different edition.
error: The ISBN on the cover does not match the ISBN of this title
errorNote: Paraphrased. Each printer words this a little differently.
why:
Every edition of a book has its own ISBN: the paperback, the hardcover and the ebook each get a different number. The barcode on your back cover has to carry the exact ISBN you entered for this edition.

It usually goes wrong when a cover is reused from another edition, or a barcode was made before the ISBN changed. The printer reads the barcode, sees a different number, and rejects the file.
manual: Look up the ISBN you entered for this exact edition in your KDP or IngramSpark book setup.
Open your cover file and read the number printed above and below the barcode.
If it's different, make a new barcode for the right ISBN (IngramSpark has a free barcode generator) or let KDP add its own barcode.
Put the new barcode in the barcode area and re-export as PDF/X-1a:2001.
Re-upload it to your printer and wait for the file review again. If it fails, you start over.
spNote: SparkPrep reads the ISBN on your cover and tells you if it doesn't match. Only you can confirm the right ISBN, so you swap in the correct barcode, re-scan, and you're ready.

cta.text: Catch an ISBN mismatch before the printer does. SparkPrep reads the barcode on your cover and checks it against your book.

faq.q: Can I use the same ISBN for my paperback and hardcover?
faq.a: No. Each format needs its own ISBN, and the barcode on each cover must match that format's ISBN.

faq.q: Does KDP add a barcode for me?
faq.a: Yes. If you leave the barcode area empty, KDP adds its own barcode for the ISBN you entered.

quickfix: SparkPrep reads the ISBN on your cover, checks it against your book, and shows you exactly what to change.
